### Input Group Static TOON Schema

name: generate_input_group_field
strict: false
schema:

            type: boolean

          visibilityCondition:

          fields:

            items:
              type: object

              properties:

                type:

                  enum[8]: string,number,boolean,dropdown,multiselect,aifield,help,"input groups"
